references.text: When Jehu was anointed king over Israel, the people took their cloaks and laid them under him on the steps—a royal honor that recalls how the crowd spread their clothes on the road before Jesus ([ref:2 Kong 9:13|2 Kings 9:13]).
Matthew's parallel account of the entry into Jerusalem, where the crowd spread their clothes on the road before Jesus ([ref:Matt 21:7-8|Matthew 21:7-8]).
Mark's parallel account of the entry into Jerusalem, where many spread their clothes on the road as Jesus rode in ([ref:Mark 11:7-8|Mark 11:7-8]).
John's account of the entry into Jerusalem, where the crowd welcomed Jesus with palm branches and shouts of praise ([ref:Joh 12:12-13|John 12:12-13]).
